metaDescription: A complete daily, monthly, and year-end bookkeeping checklist for Nepalese businesses. Maintain compliant sales registers, VAT ledgers, and bank reconciliations.
h1: A Bookkeeping Checklist for Small Businesses in Nepal
directAnswer: A compliant bookkeeping checklist for businesses in Nepal mandates daily recording of serial-numbered VAT/PAN sales invoices, weekly cash and bank reconciliations, monthly VAT purchase and sales register closures by the 25th, quarterly advance tax estimations, and annual pre-audit file compilation for independent ICAN statutory audit submission.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.contentHtml:
Maintaining clean financial books in Nepal requires disciplined standard operating procedures across three distinct operational timeframes:

1. Daily Operational Routines

  • Issue sequential, printed tax invoices containing buyer's PAN for all sales.
  • File original physical vendor tax bills chronologically in numbered voucher folders.
  • Count petty cash drawer and reconcile against cash payment receipts.

2. Monthly Statutory Closings (By the 25th of Nepali Month)

  • Export commercial bank statements and match every entry against accounting software.
  • Reconcile VAT Purchase Register (Kharid Khata) and Sales Register (Bikri Khata).
  • Calculate and deposit withholding tax (TDS) on rent, payroll, and consultancy.
  • File monthly VAT return (D-01) on the IRD portal before midnight on the 25th.

3. Fiscal Year-End Closing (Ashad 31)

  • Conduct physical year-end stock inventory count with signed count sheets.
  • Obtain formal bank balance confirmation letters directly from bank branch managers.
  • Assemble complete audit schedules for submission to external ICAN statutory auditors.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for filing a monthly VAT return late in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Late filing of VAT return D-01 incurs a statutory fine of 0.1% per day of the gross taxable turnover or NPR 1,000 per month (whichever is higher), plus interest on any unpaid tax balance.
